files.content:
# Pixel Tic-Tac-Toe

A two-player Tic-Tac-Toe game with a pixel-art aesthetic. Built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — no dependencies, no network requests, fully offline.

## Features

- Two-player local play (X goes first)
- Current turn indicator
- Win and draw detection
- Winning line highlighted with animation
- Restart button
- Keyboard accessible with ARIA labels and live status announcements
- Responsive layout from 360px wide

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or server required.

## Controls

- Click or tap a cell to place your mark
- Use Tab to navigate cells and the Restart button
- Press Enter or Space to activate a focused cell or button
- Click Restart to start a new game

## Palette

- Background: `#1a1a2e`
- Card: `#16213e`
- Accent / cells: `#0f3460`
- X: `#e94560`
- O: `#f5c542`

## Files

- `index.html` — markup
- `style.css` — pixel styling and layout
- `script.js` — game logic
